config.source:
SELECT p.product_name AS product_name, p.category AS category, p.brand AS brand,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS revenue, SUM(s.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM retail_q.gold.fact_sales s JOIN retail_q.gold.dim_product p ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name, p.category, p.brand ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
